title.zh: 天地入畫、心境成墨：袁之靜與國美館館長陳貺怡對談水墨之美
title.en: Heaven and Earth in Ink: Yuan Chi-Jing in Conversation with NTMoFA Director Chen Kuang-yi

summary.zh: 在國立彰化生活美學館，袁之靜與國美館館長陳貺怡以「天地之美、心源之境、畫中有話」三個主題，談水墨的傳承、轉化與心靈表現。
summary.en: At the National Changhua Living Art Center, the artist and the Director of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts discuss three themes — the beauty of nature, the landscape of the heart, and the stories inside a painting — and how ink painting carries tradition into the present.

summary.zh: 開幕當天，談「詩中有畫，畫中有詩」與「筆墨寫天地，詩心寫人生」的創作理念。
summary.en: At the opening, the artist speaks about her guiding ideas — “a painting within the poem, a poem within the painting” and “ink to write heaven and earth, a poet's heart to write life.”
